description: MakerWorld model specs for all 13 current 3D printed Etsy listings. Each entry maps to an Etsy listing and includes the closest matching MakerWorld model with print settings for the Bambu Lab P1S.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Desk Pen Holder | Modern Desktop Organizer
products.makerworld_model: Pen Holder – Stylish and Functional Desk Organizer
products.alternate_model: Pencil/Pen Holder for Desk (Clean and Minimalist) — model 1180012 by sigmashrek (removable dividers, 1/2/4 section config)
products.recommended_filament: PLA+ (matte finish) or Silk PLA for premium photo appeal
products.p1s_notes: Silk PLA on smooth PEI makes it pop in listing photos with zero post-processing. Print upright for best outer wall quality.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Regular Can Koozie | 12oz Standard Can Cooler Sleeve
products.makerworld_model: Cooler Can Holder (std 12oz can) — No Logo
products.recommended_filament: PLA (standard); Silk PLA for premium sheen; TPU for flexibility (slow to 25 mm/s outer wall)
products.p1s_notes: Batch 4 units per plate (88mm footprint each fits comfortably on 256mm bed). Scale ±0.5% if can fit is too snug. Silk PLA requires Flow Dynamics calibration per spool.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Skinny Can Koozie | 12oz Slim Can Cooler Sleeve
products.alternate_model: Cooler Can Holder (skinny 12oz) — model 2713736 by animuL67 (novelty cooler-jug aesthetic with handle)
products.can_compatibility: Slim/sleek 12oz cans — Red Bull, White Claw, Truly, Michelob Ultra (57mm body diameter)
products.p1s_notes: 100% infill is mandatory — the air gap is part of the geometry for insulation, not infill. TPU: slow outer wall to 25 mm/s, reduce retraction to 0.5mm. Flexible PLA is faster at standard settings.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Planter Pot | Modern Indoor Plant Pot
products.makerworld_model: Indoor Plant Pot — Mid Century Modern Planter
products.alternate_model: Modern Planter with Hidden Drainage — model 739818 by Abstractia Design (integrated hidden drainage system, 0.2mm, 15% infill)
products.recommended_filament: PETG for moisture resistance (preferred); PLA for succulents/dry plants
products.p1s_notes: Print PETG on textured PEI plate. Seal interior with XTC-3D or brush-on epoxy for water-holding plants. Low infill (8%) keeps material cost down and weight light. Do not use smooth PEI with PETG — it bonds too strongly.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Tea Light Holder Set of 2 | Boho Candle Holder
products.makerworld_model: Japandi Tea Light and Candle Holder
products.alternate_model: Modern TeaLight Candle Holders — model 852435 by SabreDesign (PLA Marble, set format, fits up to 40mm tea lights)
products.dimensions_mm: Not published (fits standard 38–40mm tea lights; dual-use: tea light or taper candle)
products.recommended_filament: PLA for LED/electric tea lights; PETG or ABS if using real flame tea lights
products.p1s_notes: Dual-use design flips between tea light and taper candle orientation. For real-flame use, PETG handles ~60–70°C ambient warmth without deforming. PLA Marble filament produces premium boho look with zero post-processing.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Can Koozie | Funny Beer Koozie | Slim Can Cooler Sleeve
products.alternate_model: Hoodie Can Koozie — model 2213071 (multiple sizes); Tactical Koozie — model 2806787
products.dimensions_mm: Fits standard 12oz cans (~65–67mm diameter body). Does NOT fit slim or oversized cans.
products.recommended_filament: Silk PLA (premium sheen, community top pick); also PLA or TPU
products.infill_pct: Custom hollow panels (designer-specified — do not change)
products.p1s_notes: The puffer jacket puffed panels are the novelty element — hollow void structure provides mild insulation. 4-wall construction is critical; reducing walls collapses the puffer aesthetic. Silk PLA: run Flow Dynamics calibration, outer wall 50 mm/s max for clean panel definition.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Geometric Table Lamp | Modern Home Decor Accent Light
products.makerworld_model: Modern Easy to Print Geometric Lamp
products.alternate_model: Honeycomb Table Lamp — model 1740058; Geometric Core RGB Lamp — model 1576059; Desklamp with Modern Geometric Pattern — model 1482642
products.dimensions_mm: Not published (optimized for Bambu Lab wired lamp kit fit)
products.recommended_filament: Translucent or white PLA/PETG for best light diffusion
products.p1s_notes: 0.28mm Extra Draft profile speeds production runs. White or natural PLA diffuses lamp kit light most evenly — layer lines show through attractively at 0.28mm (intentional). Geometric facets create dramatic shadow/light interplay.
products.hardware_required: Bambu Lab wired lamp kit (sold separately ~$15–20)

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Table Centerpiece | Boho Dining Table Decor
products.makerworld_model: Boho Rainbow Arch Decor Wood Look
products.alternate_model: Boho-Style 3D Printed Flower Vase — model 1129861 by mini_zen (vase-style centerpiece for dried flowers)
products.recommended_filament: Wood-fill PLA (authentic wood grain); or bright/translucent PLA for backlit effect
products.p1s_notes: Very flat geometry (12mm deep) = virtually zero warp risk. Three sizes combine as a centerpiece set. Consider ironing the top face for smoother wood-look finish. All three sizes fit simultaneously on 256mm P1S bed for one-plate set production.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Tea Light Candle Holder Set | Boho Candleholder
products.alternate_model: Modern TeaLight Candle Holders — model 852435 by KefmaDE (PLA Marble, sized for Bambu Lab LED tea lights and standard tea lights up to 40mm)
products.dimensions_mm: Small (designer: scale as needed for desired size)
products.recommended_filament: PLA+ (matte) or PLA Marble for boho aesthetic
products.p1s_notes: Enable Fuzzy Skin (contour) in Bambu Studio for an organic, soft textured surface — enhances the boho aesthetic without any post-processing. PLA Marble is a community top pick for this style.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Mesh Table Lamp with Shade | Geometric Bedside Lamp
products.alternate_model: Mesh Lamp 1.0 — model 1681810 (~14.5 hrs confirmed print time reference)
products.recommended_filament: Translucent PLA or PETG Translucent (light diffusion through mesh lattice)
products.bulb_socket: E27 standard (40mm thread hole; adjustable in slicer)
products.p1s_notes: Longest print in the catalog at ~14.5 hrs — run overnight. Organic lattice casts warm textured shadows. Use Extra Draft 0.28mm profile to shave ~2 hrs off print time if surface quality allows. Translucent PETG on textured PEI plate for durability.
products.hardware_required: E27 lamp socket and cord (sold separately at hardware store)

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Coffee Bar Sign | Funny Cat Kitchen Decor
products.makerworld_model: Funny Coffee Sign / Wall Art / Decor / Kitchen
products.alternate_model: Coffeeology Sign — model 1127677 same designer (grey + white AMS, kitchen/coffee bar); Cat Drinking Coffee Keychain — model 224300 (pairs as a set)
products.dimensions_mm: Small (designer: scale to desired wall art size)
products.recommended_filament: PLA 2-color (grey + white is community standard; any 2-tone combo works)
products.color_method: Load 2 colors into AMS (filament slots 1 + 2), or pause at layer 15 for manual filament swap
products.p1s_notes: AMS 2-color mode makes multi-color signs trivially easy on the P1S. Scale up 150–200% for a wall art sized piece. The cat graphic on the Etsy listing may be from the 'Coffeeology Sign' variant or a custom design layered on top.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Ribbed Vase for Dried Flowers | Matte Black Boho Vase
products.makerworld_model: Ribbed Black Vase with Weighted Base
products.alternate_model: Minimal Ribbed Vase — model 2245126 (74×74×128mm, 0.16mm, vase mode, 0% infill, ~2–3 hrs); Dual-Texture Modern Vase (Ribbed/Fuzzy) — model 1589913
products.recommended_filament: Matte black PLA (boho Etsy standard); wood-color PLA adds visual interest
products.post_processing: Add ~150g modeling clay to base interior post-print for stability with tall dried flower arrangements (pampas grass, etc.)
products.p1s_notes: Matte black PLA on smooth PEI gives a premium matte finish straight off the plate — no sanding or finishing needed. Weighted base with modeling clay is key differentiator for tall dried flower stability. The Minimal Ribbed Vase alternate is faster to produce at true vase/spiral mode.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Crystal Glow Lamp | Faceted Geometric Table Lamp
products.makerworld_model: Crystal Wireless Lamp — RGB Magical Crystals
products.alternate_model: Crystal Lamp by Archork — model 217505 (translucent blue PLA top + black PLA base, traditional E14 bulb, no special hardware); Mystic Crystal Lamp — model 1581547
products.dimensions_mm: Scalable (designed to sit over Bambu Lab wireless RGB puck light)
products.recommended_filament: PETG Translucent Clear (Clear 32101 — allows RGB light to diffuse through faceted crystal surfaces)
products.p1s_notes: PETG Translucent Clear on textured PEI plate — do NOT use smooth PEI (PETG bonds too aggressively). The faceted crystal surfaces refract RGB light for prismatic effect. No wiring needed — crystals simply sit over the wireless puck. Print a second color (e.g., translucent blue or pink) for variety in the same listing.
products.hardware_required: Bambu Lab Wireless RGB Puck Light (sold separately ~$15–20)

hardware_required_products.hardware: Bambu Lab Wireless RGB Puck Light (~$15–20)
